Former fighter Josh Thompson and famed referee Big John McCarthy headline Rogan's MMA Show number 179. McCarthy helped write the sport's unified rules. Thompson fought at top levels for years.

Rogan draws on both men for a deep rules and history talk. They recall how the sport grew from outlaw shows to arenas. Fights, calls, and judging errors get close review. The episode is a fight nerd's delight: two men who shaped the cage from inside it, explaining how the modern sport was built. Their bond with Rogan runs deep and shows.

Activist Charlie Kirk sits down with Tucker Carlson to talk about debt, youth anger, and party politics. Kirk leads a large conservative youth movement in the United States. The title frames his core claim about generational blame.

Kirk says heavy student and household debt has pushed young voters toward sharper politics. The talk also ranges over the Russia probe and media trust. Carlson presses him on why older leaders missed the shift. The episode gives a clear window into Kirk's pitch to young conservatives. The result is part policy talk and part campaign pitch.
